entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'representative' to speak with an agent.
Representative.
Connecting you now.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex, I'd like to start a return for an order I received a couple of weeks ago.
I can certainly help with that. Do you have the order number handy?
Yes, it's VF-78-90-12.

Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order was delivered about 15 days ago. It looks like you're looking to return two items: a Pro-Weave cycling jersey and a VeloFit Pulse heart rate monitor. Is that correct?
That's the one. Neither of them really worked out for me, so I want to send them both back.
I understand. I'm looking at our return eligibility now. I can definitely process the return for the jersey for you right away. That's no problem at all.
Okay, great. And what about the monitor?
This is where it gets a bit complicated. Because your order contained both apparel and an electronic device, we have separate policies that apply to each item type.
Separate policies? I bought them at the same time.

I understand the confusion. The jersey falls under our standard 30-day apparel return window, so you're well within the timeframe for that. However, for electronic items like the Pulse monitor, our policy is a 14-day return from the date of delivery.
Wait, what? It was delivered 15 days ago. You're telling me I can't return it because of one day? That's ridiculous!
I do apologize for the frustration. I know it's a strict cutoff, but the 14-day policy for electronics is firm. I am unable to process a return for the Pulse monitor since it's outside that window.
This is unbelievable. So I'm just stuck with a piece of equipment I don't want? This is not good customer service.

I truly understand your position, and I'm very sorry for the inconvenience. While I can't override the system for the monitor, I can immediately email you a prepaid return label for the jersey. You'll receive a full refund for it as soon as our warehouse receives the item.
(Sighs) Fine. I guess getting half my money back is better than nothing. I just wish this was more clear when I bought it.

I appreciate that feedback, and I will absolutely pass it along to our website team to see how we can improve the clarity around our policies. Would you like me to send that return label for the jersey to the email address on file?
Yes, please do that. Well, thank you for your help with the jersey, at least. I appreciate you explaining everything.
You're very welcome. I've just sent that email, it should arrive in the next few minutes. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you, Alex.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great rest of your day.
